positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Created a backend Python program to automatically output discrepancies in two data feeds. Critical to Morningstar's operations in consolidating and adding new data feeds. Deployed on AWS Lambda using CDK.
- Created front-end UI to monitor and display statistics about any data feed retrieval failures. Increased efficiency in alerting developers of client issues. Showcased previously unknown statistics to improve understanding of problems.
- As a separate project with other interns, created fullstack add-on for Microsoft Outlook to simplify scheduling hybrid in-person and digital meetings. Currently being used over the default Outlook scheduler by two teams. Written in Javascript and Python, and deployed to AWS using SAM.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked with Prof. Qirun Zhang applying static program analysis techniques to persistent memory models of computing.

positions.title: Admissions Fellow
positions.description: Conduct interviews of prospective students and evaluate potential fit for the school.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Worked with Prof. Joshua Brody to prove a significant lemma in the field of
computational complexity theory. Paper submitted 2020.
